data.title: Man Huang Xian Jie
data.synopsis:
In the vast and wild fairyland, the culture of cultivating immortals prevails, and mortals are proud to become cultivators. College student, Lu Hangzhi,  transmigrated from the modern times and became a mortal servant in Ziyun Town. 

He lived a life of treading on thin ice every day, but he refused to accept his fate and worked hard to get rid of his status quo and strived to get ahead. Later, because of a good deed, he was appreciated by Zhu Fuqin, the eldest lady of the Zhu Mansion, and his senior brother Leng Wuya. 

With unremitting efforts, he passed many tests and joined the Xuanxin Sect. He was promoted from an outer disciple to an inner disciple, and was even favored by the deputy head Chen Ji and took him in. He cut his way through obstacles and moved forward on the road of cultivating immortals. 

(source: Qiyi)

data.title: Zhanshen Lianmeng
data.synopsis:
After a magnetic storm strikes the Blue Star Continent, spiritual energy is revived, transforming both humans and animals. This triggers a battle for survival between spirit beasts and humans. Ling Tian, a young prodigy with an ancient divine bloodline and a treasure called the 'God Brain,' discovers that in three years, the continent will face a disaster that will lead to his heroic death. Guided by Yan Ling, his assistant from the future, he embarks on a mission to attain ultimate power and change the continent's fate.

(Source: SIMLK)

data.title: Xian Ji Xun Zong
data.synopsis:
The protagonist, Lin Chu, was born into a wealthy and prestigious family. However, his parents suddenly disappeared without a trace, the family company was seized by his father's former assistant, and even the villa he had lived in since childhood was taken over by so-called creditors. Forced to temporarily reside in the Lin family's old mansion in the suburbs, Lin Chu was surprised to find mysterious voices emanating from a bonsai tree in the courtyard. He unexpectedly entered the bonsai and discovered a sacred mountain and an immortal—Xuanqing Patriarch—sealed within. Xuanqing Patriarch realized Lin Chu possessed the ability to break the seal and decided to take him as a disciple, teaching him cultivation methods so he can break the seal. At the same time, to repay Lin Chu, Xuanqing Patriarch also agreed to teach him some skills to help him investigate the truth behind his parents' disappearance. Lin Chu agreed to Xuanqing Patriarch's request and thus embarked on the path of cultivation!

(Source: Youku, translated)

data.title: Denglong Dao
data.synopsis:
Liu Ruyan, the daughter of the Liu family, was brutally murdered by the living dead under the command of the Old Mother of No Life on her wedding day. Fortunately, she was rescued by Lantern Blade, who was searching for the whereabouts of the Black Tai Sui. Liu Ruyan vowed revenge and began to wander with Lantern Blade. One day, the two arrived at a dilapidated town where various forces gathered. Amidst the undercurrents, Miss Liu's true identity gradually surfaced, and a great battle was about to break out.

(Source: Bangumi, translated)
